nodes.comment: When the feet aren\'t moving (e.g. during Idle), offset the root in the opposite direction to the Pawn owner\'s rotation to keep the mesh from rotating with the Pawn.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_0
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: When in motion, smoothly blend out the offset.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_4
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Reset to blending out the yaw offset. Each update, a state needs to request to accumulate or hold the offset. Otherwise, the offset will blend out.
This is primarily because the majority of states want the offset to blend out, so this saves on having to tag each state.
